diagnosis: The v0.1 benchmark correctly shows that a single binary qualification discards information about design capability, but raw MDE values were reported even for nuisance-amplitude levels whose beta=0 Wilson upper bound exceeded the declared Type-I ceiling. Such MDE values are nominal detectability diagnostics, not evaluable-envelope claims.
substantive_implication: The deliberately source-concentrated design has the same unique relation variance as the broad reference design but materially inflated null rejection. Signal concentration and detectability/calibration are therefore distinct properties, and inverse-Herfindahl endpoint counts must not be interpreted as effective sample sizes.
